name: Chugin Financial Group Inc
summary: Chugin Financial Group, Inc. offers a comprehensive suite of financial services, primarily through its key subsidiary, The Chugoku Bank, Limited. The company organizes its operations into distinct Banking, Leasing, and Securities divisions. It provides a diverse array of deposit products, encompassing checking, savings, and various time deposits, along with specialized accounts for non-residents, tax payments, offshore purposes, and foreign currency holdings. Beyond deposits, its service portfolio extends to credit guarantees, credit card solutions, investment management and advisory services, financial instruments brokerage, asset management, and a variety of loan offerings. Furthermore, the group undertakes administrative outsourcing and facilitates the leasing and installment sale of properties and goods. Established in 1930 and headquartered in Okayama, Japan, the firm maintains an extensive operational footprint, including a head office, 137 branch locations (comprising numerous sub-branches and branch-in-branch offices), and 234 ATMs across Japan. Internationally, it extends its reach with one branch and four representative offices.
